title: Three-bit conditional-description encoding
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, take the unary product of the encoding of the pair consisting of the true-bit positions in its second decoded component and the unary product of the encoding of the pair formed by the halting-word transformation of its first decoded component and the three-element list containing only true bits.
caveat: The precise meanings of unary product, pairing, and the halting-word transformation are not supplied.
